name: hush
description: The Energy fleet's secrets-management domain-expert employee as one installable Claude Code plugin: bundles the `hush` CLI, the `hush` stdio MCP server, the five secrets skills, the secret-scan-gate hook, and the two sub-agent personas. Install to scan a repo for leaked secrets, get the real (rotate-first) remediation, wire a scanner/SOPS+age setup, broker a short-TTL credential handle, and refuse the false-greens — always returning handles, never raw secret values. Boundary: not auth (that's badge). Powered by Energy.

hook.name: secret-scan-gate
hook.description: Parse-time block of a seeded secret-shaped string (entropy + prefix sk-ant-/AKIA/ghp_) and of a non-${VAR} literal written into .mcp.json (brain P-16). The inherited protect-secrets.js (credential files) is kept alongside it via a second matcher (Q-13).

install_instructions: Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings → Plugins → Add local plugin → select the hush repo root. The `hush` CLI commands, the five secrets skills, the two sub-agent personas (hush-remediation-planner, hush-tool-selector), and the secret-scan-gate hook become available. The `hush` MCP server is wired via .mcp.json (env-ref tokens, no live keys) — run `pnpm build` first so dist/mcp/server.js exists. HARD invariant: hush returns handles/verdicts, never raw secret values (O-09).
